messages:
maya: Quick microcopy check — the dashboard rate-limit banner currently says: 'Rate limit reached. Try again in 2m.' Does that feel too vague/dismissive? wondering if we should 1) expand the verb for clarity, 2) add an action, and 3) include an accessibility hint.

jon: I think 'Try again in 2m' is okay for skimmability but it doesn't tell users what to do if they're blocked. Maybe: 'You're sending requests too fast. Try again in 2 minutes or upgrade your plan.'

lina: +1 to including next steps. Also prefer writing '2 minutes' (words) not '2m' for localization/readability. Consider two variants for testing: short vs contextual.

sam: For accessibility, we should ensure the banner is announced by screen readers. Add aria-live="polite" and a visually-hidden detailed line like 'If you need more throughput, see billing and quotas.'

copybot: Copy options (shortlist):
1) "You're sending requests too quickly — try again in 2 minutes or see quota details."
2) "Rate limit reached. Retry in 2 minutes or upgrade your plan for higher throughput."
3) "Temporarily limited: wait 2 minutes or visit billing to increase your quota."

maya: Nice. My preference is option 1 for tone, but add explicit link to quota docs. Also request a soft CTA button 'View quota' (secondary) so users don't have to hunt.

jon: UX nit — keep the main banner CTA focused. Secondary button ok. For mobile, 'View quota' should be inline text link not a button to save vertical space.

lina: Can we add a microcopy rule: always spell out time, avoid 'm', and never show raw numbers alone (e.g., '2' without unit). This will help translators.

sam: Suggest aria phrasing: aria-live="polite" text: 'Rate limit reached. Try again in two minutes. To increase throughput, visit quota settings.' That reads nicely for AT consumers.

maya: Action items: 1) Design to mock banner with two states (compact and expanded with link + secondary CTA) — @jon to do mobile alternative. 2) Engineering to set aria-live and check screen reader read order — @sam. 3) Copy to land on option 1 with spelled-out times and link — @lina.

jon: I'll post a quick mock in #design-assets by EOD. :thumbsup:

lina: I'll update the copy doc and add translation notes.

sam: I'll add the aria attribute to the alert component and run a quick VoiceOver pass.

maya: Thanks all — let's A/B the short vs contextual line for one week and measure clickthrough on 'View quota'.
